text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "—Excuse me. Um..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh. Zephyr, over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Curren and Chan-chan are out buying 
ingredients for the cake. So I figured the 
two of us could review yesterday's stream 
first."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The whole point of this project is to 
entertain people, after all. Gotta check 
the reactions, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, Zephyr, it's pretty unusual 
for you... to join in on this kind of 
social media project, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. To me, it felt like hoisting a sail 
in a calm breeze... but since the wind has 
picked up, I thought I would let myself be 
guided with an open heart."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore... in the intention to bring 
joy to our fans, I felt a favorable wind."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If it was simply good timing... then the 
same applies to me. I sympathized with 
their desire to care for the fans, which 
led me to participate."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine's Day can now be considered a 
cultural moment for expressing one's 
feelings. It is a fitting occasion for us 
to convey our gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I guess we're all on the same 
page there. Even if we're not used to it, 
let's just give it everything we've got—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We have a crisis!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"W-What's wrong? Uh, anyway, welcome 
back...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I have returned. I have returned. I have 
returned... And it is a grave situation!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan-chan and the others are nowhere to be 
found on the trending list!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Have you calmed down, Marchan-san?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, Chan-chan is very calm. Indeed. Like 
a good puppy lying down in front of its 
meal. Yes."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oho, she is definitely not calm at all~

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "So, what... is this 'trending'...?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Trending refers to a mechanism where 
words posted by many people are ranked as 
high-interest topics."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it was an impromptu stream, and our 
very first one. Isn't it normal that 
people aren't talking about it yet?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, no!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Not being talked about means fewer people 
are watching... That won't make 
Valentine's Day fun and exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, the problem is not merely 
that Chan-chan and the others failed to 
trend."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"? What do you mean—... Ah. This number 
one trending topic, don't tell me..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it is exactly what you think! It is 
a keyword related to a Valentine's project 
launched last night by other influencers!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"People are definitely curious about that 
kind of topic. Everybody does it this time 
of year~"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So we got buried, huh? Hahaa, the 
terrifying Warring States period of social 
media... a ruthless Valentine's marketing 
war..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr... In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —We must overhaul the plan!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We need to rework our content! First, we 
must spread the word of Chan-chan's 
activities to the world."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"True, we managed to announce that we're 
doing Valentine's. Should we show off more 
of our unique personalities from here on?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Personalities...! Yes, that's it, 
Curren-san!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If we put out more unique and impactful 
videos, we should be able to reach many 
more fans!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Let us do this!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"In addition to the main stream and the 
two mini-streams beforehand—we shall also 
post short videos!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If we put out lots of insanely fun and 
cute videos showcasing everyone's unique 
charm, it will create a massive buzz and 
bring joy to all. That is the master 
plan."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Please leave the very first one to 
Chan-chan. I have a premise that perfectly 
showcases individuality!"
